sources.move_on_rule: the move-on rule's floor and ceiling (TODO(m6-ladder-move-on): plan data the leveling optimizer seat owns, m6-plan.md section 2.1; neither is a constant): kills_an_hour_floor = half the band's modelled kills/h, rounded down; casts_a_kill_ceiling = twice the band's modelled casts a kill, where the modelled casts a kill is the band's s a kill times 3.4/19.6 (M5's measured den kill: 3.4 attack casts in 19.6 s, strategy section 1.1), rounded to 0.1. Both inputs are the strategy section 1.2 row of the band; a row marked assumed there makes the derived value assumed. What the level up job does when a rung falls under its floor or over its ceiling (move on, step back or report) is slice a4's and the optimizer's. M6 14 (D135; the lead's brief of 2026-11-13: a rung moves on when the next rung's portal admits her and its gate reads open, the bands staying the latest she moves; Autopilot/RungOwner.Ahead): before its band the rung after the band's rung, one rung and never two, is taken when all of these hold: it is a ground rung the fight can hunt; it has a gate (a rung with none is never taken early: unknown never opens a gate); its entry portal and a route of travel-routes.json admit her level (the Town Network's 10, the Facility Hub's 15 to 40, the entries' own: facts of the world); its gate reads open on what is known (the run's live buffs, a start's standing lines); and she is at least the plan's climber of its first level: her base War Magic, no buff, is at least the projection the spell levels are computed on (SpellPlan.ProjectedWarBase) at that level. The bands are the plan's climber's, so the plan's own climber moves on at the band and a stronger character as soon as the portals and the gate let her. Without that last condition the buff bot's lines open every gate and the portals alone would send a climber to the Cave at 15 past the Lodge, the Abode at 21, the Quarters at 30 and the Holding at 60, earlier than the levels the study rates safe and paying. A run on the rung ahead stays there while they hold, its gate read at each way out as every run's ground's is; the floor and the ceiling stay report-only
sources.spell_level: each rung's spell_level is computed, never assumed (D4, D41, D26; M6 item 1 a, Mage/SpellPlan.cs, pinned by SpellPlanTests): min is the highest level of the rung's bolt line cast at plan_cast_chance on the climber's projected BASE War Magic at the band's first level, max the same at its last level (the top rung at 126). The projection: War Magic specialised at creation (ACE InitLevel 10, Player_Skills.cs:236 @95ef426d), round((Focus + Self) / 4) over the creation values 100 and 100 plus the planner's ranks, and MageSpendingPlanner.Compute at the level's total experience (the dats' XpTable), MageBuild.Traditional, the spender's shares for her (MageTemplate.SharesFor: MageShares.Climber, M6 item 14: the magic skills of the named list, Focus and Self, Mana Conversion, Max Mana, then Endurance, Max Health and Max Stamina; Max Health and Endurance held to 5% of the experience earned each, every other attribute to 10%), after the climber's health floor (Mage/ClimberHealthRule.cs, M6 7 R; a rung's higher floor lowers the plan, never the ranks she holds, so the skill of a rung's last level stands until the plan passes it), every later magic skill counted trained; no buff (the plan is conservative; the run reads the current skill). ACE's chance is SkillCheck.GetMagicSkillChance (SkillCheck.cs:19-22 @95ef426d, difficulty = the spell's power, Player_Magic.cs:530-536): 43 over the power is 0.9530 and 42 over is 0.9498, so the plan's skill for a level is its power + 43 (II 93, III 143, IV 193, V 243, VI 293, VII 343)

sources.vitals: M6 7 lead, live 2026-11-06 21:15 UTC: mana_loop_under 45, not 30: the loop acts while a stamina drain (10) and the press after it (10) and a bolt can still be paid; at 30 she spent her way to 13, drained, and stood with 3 mana and 91 stamina. M6 7 AN, the owner's direction of 2026-11-06, every ground, not only level 80 (D91's reach widened): drain_under_percent 50: at or below half her health she drains the fullest target in reach, the level by best heal; the model's sweep at a pack of five gave deaths of 43% at 30, 39% at 40, 35% at 50, 44% at 60. mana_loop_under 30 is two bolts of the rung's Flame Bolt II and III (10 and 15 mana); mana_loop_stamina_percent 50: Stamina to Mana I gives 0.45 of her stamina for 10 mana (it nets 2.8 at half a bar of 57, 15.6 at the top), so under half Drain Stamina comes first; the target's stamina is read live, never the ground's name; pass_home_over_lines 4: stretch 7's passes cost 42 mana a line (8 casts, 340 mana) on a pool of 194, so four lines are a bar of mana and a fifth needs a rest, and a rest needs her lying down; buff_pass_wait_seconds 900: slice AK's full pass is 18 casts and about 650 base mana on a pool of 154, so about 500 mana by the recharge at the owner's estimate of 0.8 a second overall, 625 s, plus about a minute of casts and a third for fizzles and a rest cut short; past it the pass goes on with what stands, names what is missing, and those lines are not due again for as long: never a fail, never a stop of the run; start_only_lines is the owner's to fill: empty keeps every line up during a fight; M6 14 (m6-banes, the owner's order of 2026-11-12: every armour protection on her armour before the Direlands): the six other armour banes need no entry here: her pass at home casts all eight armour lines, and in a ground one of the six is kept up only where a target deals its damage type (Mage/ArmourBanes.cs, the profiles' damage_types), because the eight come due together: the live log of 2026-11-12 at levels 35 to 37, ten enchantable pieces worn, reads 3.05 s a level IV armour cast and 1 to 90 mana a cast with her Mana Conversion 206 (nine casts, mean 25; the price before conversion is 40 + 8 x 10 = 120, level V 150) on a pool of 323, so a pass of the eight is about 25 s and 200 mana (960 at the worst) at home, where buff_pass_wait_seconds lets her rest for it, and would be 25 s with no bolt under the fight's hard floor; refresh_mana_reserve 60 (M6 7 AZ, live 2026-11-06 23:25 to 23:27 UTC at level 19: a refresh in a lull spent her mana from 200 to 3 and she died in the pass's wait): a stamina drain needs 20 and the press after it 10, the mana loop starts at 45 (mana_loop_under) and a bolt is 10 to 15, so 60 keeps the loop and a drain payable; a refresh in a fight starts no new line below it; M6 8 H (the owner, 2026-11-09: the enemy's stamina feeds her mana, sums in cache/m6/8/drain-sums.md): the climber's loop by the sum (ManaLoopRule.DecideBySum): mana_press_min_bolts 0.5 (a press alone must net half a bolt: it spends about one cast), stamina_drain_min_bolts 1.0 (a drain and its press, two casts, must net a bolt: the sums' line, never on the outskirts and always from the Burrow up), mana_loop_max_attackers 2 (a pair is about 5 s of no damage, at the Lodge about 6 health per attacker, and the pack does not shrink), mana_loop_bolt_first_hits 1 (a pair is about 5 s for at most a bolt's mana, and 56% of the outskirts kills are one bolt), mana_loop_bolts_between 2 (a chain of mana casts must not stall the kill); M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: she never drains stamina and runs low on it, so the loop drains stamina to stay efficient; his standing rules M5 D88, mana to near empty and stamina near full, and 2026-11-09, the target's stamina drained regularly and turned into mana): the live Abode of 2026-11-13 04:09 to 04:30 UTC (level 40, stamina 221, mana 332, Flame Bolt V about 5 mana a cast with her Mana Conversion, Tusker Redeemers holding 480 stamina each) decided 115 times none, 28 presses and 1 drain: the presses came at mana 320 to 325 of 332 and netted 5.6 to 10.6 mana for 3 to 13 stamina each, a drain was valued only by the mana of the press after it, so at near-full mana it never beat a press, and her stamina sat at 84 to 102 of 221: stamina went on top-ups and was never refilled. stamina_keep_percent 80: under it the loop's first move is Drain Stamina Other on the fullest target in reach, valued in stamina (at least stamina_drain_min_give), read whenever she is under the line, her mana full or not; she must still pay a bolt after it (the drain's mana and the bolt's), no bolt may be owed (mana_loop_bolts_between, which a stamina drain owes as a press does) and its target is not the bolt's target when that dies to the next bolt (another is drained, or the line waits a bolt); 80% of 221 is 177, so the cap's 60 from a Redeemer lands whole from 161 down. stamina_drain_max_attackers 4 (the Abode's live hits under the buff bot's 28 lines: Redeemers hit her 1 to 4 points, the largest 10, on 156 health; a live drain took 3.8 s, so four attackers through it are about 16 health at the usual hit and 40 at the largest): more than four keep the bolts first; mana_loop_max_attackers 2 still holds the mana casts. mana_press_fill_percent 90: before a bolt she can pay, the press is the level that nets the most when nothing is cut, and it goes only when the mana she is missing takes at least 90% of its give, so her mana runs down to about the maximum less the give and the press lands whole (the live level I presses at stamina 175 to 213 gave 9 to 28 mana of a give of 45); a bolt she cannot pay is pressed for as before (mana_press_min_bolts holds in both)

The owner's correction of 2026-11-06 (M6 7 AR): the Burrow is a rung again and has its own gate: Armor Self IV and Bludgeoning Protection Self IV with the bootstrap they need (Focus Self II, Willpower Self II, Life Magic Mastery Self III, the first_scrolls), each learned and up, so she does not leave the outskirts until the two lines have landed; Impenetrability III and Bludgeon Bane III join them (the owner, 2026-11-06: level 16, at least level III item spells, before the tuskers; the Burrow's are tuskers too, and the Burrow's minimum kit is the owner's to lower). Gates chain (rung_gates, climbing order; Mage/RungGateRule.Walk): a shut gate holds her on the rung before it, so a shut Lodge gate holds her on the Burrow past its one level, and a shut Burrow gate on the outskirts. On a gate's own ground that gate is not read again M6 7 AX: the Cave has a gate of the same shape, because a Crimsonback (DVal 40, variance 0.75, Strength 200) hits 1.833 times a Male Tusker: 65 is its mean unarmoured hit, its largest 104 and a critical 208, not the 130 of the rule audit, which doubled the mean. The Lodge's lines, with Armor Self V and Bludgeoning Protection V (power 200, Life Magic 216 at the 0.75 buff bar; the Master Scriveners' scrolls, by the Town Network). The numbers: 95 live hits of Male Tuskers at Armor IV, Protection IV, Impenetrability III and Bane III, mean 3.79, largest normal 6, a live critical 12, scaled by 1.833; the model cache/m6/7/ax/fightsim_ax.py, death a fight at health 95 and mana 200 (Crimsonback 110 health, Magic Defense 94): IV and IV: pack of 4 8.5%, pack of 6 84%; V and V: pack of 4 2.2%, pack of 6 19.8%; III and III: pack of 4 54%. The kit decides it, health hardly does (V and V, pack of 4: 3.0% at health 80, 2.5% at 130), so the gate holds no health condition and health stays the rule's (health_hits, want 130, paid by level 29). With the items lapsed the pack of 4 is 99.8%, so Impenetrability and Bane stay. Not cured: a pack of 8 is 97% at V and V; 13 of the Cave's 81 slots stand in packs of 7 or 8, read with no line-of-sight check, so an upper bound: TODO(m6-cave-big-packs). Until M6 14 the level 32 band (the Temple 20-40's) had no gate, so a shut Cave gate did not hold her past 31. M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40): the Abode has a gate of the Cave's shape, the same lines at the same levels, so a climber whose lines are down is held in the Cave: a Tusker Redeemer (DVal 50, variance 0.75, Strength 200; the rung's health.hitter) hits 82, 1.26 times a Crimsonback's 65 and 2.28 times a Male Tusker's 36, so the Abode asks no less than the Cave. Whether it asks more (Armor Self VI and Bludgeoning Protection VI, power 250, Life Magic 266 at the 0.75 buff bar) is not modelled: the AX model's rows are the Crimsonback's (TODO(m6-abode-fight-live)). Gates chain: a shut Abode gate holds her at 39, on the Cave (Mage/RungGateRule.Walk), where the Cave's own gate is read in turn unless she stands in the Cave; with the Temple's rung gone the Cave's band covers 32 to 39, so the hole D113 named is closed up to 59. It stays open above: the Quarters' band (60 to 74) and the Holding's have no gate, so a shut Abode gate did not hold her past 59 (m6-gate-past-the-cave, narrowed to the rungs past the Abode; closed by D135 below). M6 14 (D135, the owner, 2026-11-13: the island from 10 and the earlier bands): every rung from the Burrow on has a gate, and a later gate holds every line an earlier one holds, at its level or more, and its skills (a gate that reads open is the only one read, Mage/RungGateRule.Walk; LadderTests pins it). The Lodge's lines rise to the Burrow's (Focus Self II, Willpower Self II, Life Magic Mastery Self III, Armor Self and Bludgeoning Protection at IV or the highest she can reach), so a climber without the buff bot's lines is held outside until her own two IV lines stand, as the hold of 2026-11-06 asked, whatever her level; the Cave and the Abode keep V; the Quarters (from 42) has the Abode's gate; the Holding (from 65) asks Armor Self and Bludgeoning Protection at VII, the bot's level (a Rampager's mean hit, 293, is 3.6 times a Redeemer's and unmeasured, and the bot's power-300 lines are what the study's safe level rests on: cache/m6/optimal-climb/study.md section 4 item 6), so a climber without the bot's lines is held in the Quarters. Where the study's safe level rests on the bot (the Burrow at 10, the Holding at 65) the gate reads the bot's lines live, by the gates' second form. m6-gate-past-the-cave is closed: no band past the outskirts is ungated M6 retreat (the owner, 2026-11-19): the 10-14 rung's ground is the Tusker Retreat, whose hardest hitter is the Lodge's Male Tusker (hit 36 against the Burrow's Female, 34) in packs of up to 7 (the rung's health.pack); the burrow gate's lines are unchanged, and whether those packs ask the Lodge's fuller lines is not modelled (TODO(m6-retreat-live))
sources.health_hits: 2: N of the health floor (the owner's correction, 2026-11-05; Mage/ClimberHealthRule.cs): the climber's base health before the shares takes two hits of the rung's hardest hitter, a hit being ACE's mean uncritical unarmoured hit (LadderHitter.Hit: DVal x (1 - DVar / 2) x the attribute modifier max(1, 1 + (Strength - 55) x 0.011), @95ef426d WorldObjects/Monster_Melee.cs:385-404, Entity/BaseDamage.cs, Entity/DamageEvent.cs DoCalculateDamage, WorldObjects/SkillFormula.cs:18-23). Why this figure and not the largest hit: it sits where the live hits' tail does: 355 hits of a Female Tusker (hit 34) on a level-61 mage under Armor Self III read p50 8, p90 28, p95 37, p99 48, max 103 (cache/m6/7/live r1c), so one figure is about the 95th percentile of what really lands, armour worn, and the 10% criticals (ACE doubles the largest hit, WorldObject_Weapon.cs:291,356) are what makes the tail. Why two: the hit that lands while a heal winds up, and the next: a mage who can take two can answer the first (the guard's heal, the emergency drain). Payable: with the pay limit each rung's want is reached inside the rung but the Burrow's, whose road is the Goldenback's: level 16 for the Lodge's 72, level 29 for the Cave's 130, level 33 for the Temple's 142, level 42 for the Abode's 164, level 66 for the Quarters' 204 (ClimberHealthRuleTests). What fails otherwise: N = 2 on the largest hit (226 at the Temple) or N = 3 on the mean is never paid at any rung from the Cave on (health 200 prices 48M, 250 prices 684M; level 60 has earned 129M), so the pay limit would take its whole share of every level to the top; N = 1 asks 65 on the Cave, which the shares reach alone by level 26, so the level-30 test character's three-hit death (69 health, 86 in three Crimsonback hits) stands; at N = 2 she holds 132 there M6 7 AY (the owner, 2026-11-06: the rule counts the whole pack, not one attacker): each rung's health.pack is the pack it sends at her, and the want is the hit x (N + (pack - 1) x (N - 1)), Mage/ClimberHealthRule.PackHits: the hardest hitter's two hits and one more from each other attacker in the same window (the swings are not in step; the Lodge's gaps measured 2.1 to 3.4 s). Pack 1 is the rule of before. The hit stays the figure above.

sources.vitals_policy: M6 14 (m6-vitals-policy; the owner, 2026-11-13: her mana casts by the numbers from her stats and the creature, experience an hour first, fights ending near full without top-ups; the model and its sums: cache/m6/mana/model.md, every formula ACE's at 95ef426d): on true: the climber's mana loop is Vitals/VitalsPolicy.cs, not ManaLoopRule.DecideBySum (whose vitals lines stay for every other path and character). sources.ground: tusker-holding (0x5B48): M6 3 p2, the profile drafted from the dats and the pinned world SQL v0.9.296 (GroundDraft, lean 0.3): entry gate MinLevel 60, no max (item 0's W0 agrees), PortalBitmask 0x31 (NoRecall: not tieable); one 5-minute generator 7924 with 184 slots (136 x Rampager 10810, 44 x 16916, 4 x 22599 which holds the Rampager Tusk 22429), level 100, 435 health, Magic Defense 251 (ACE's current value; the sheets, sel-creatures.tsv and the spec say 230, the bare skill); no creature of the ground casts, so none is kill-first; the 18 Tusker's Friend plates strip buffs (TODO(m6-holding-plates), no hazard field yet). The walk reaches 305 of the 712 cells and 102 of the 184 slots (M6 14 pits; the Abode's layout: the east half on foot, 54 slots, the west half by a running jump over the pit 0x5B4802A9, 48 slots); the lower level and the exit are reached only by a drop off the brink, one way, so 81 slots stand where no walk reaches and one in the pit cell itself (TODO(m6-abode-lower-level); TODO(m6-holding-pockets) is closed). Home, vendors, kit, supplies and the spell plan are the den's, because the Holding's 30-minute read is BSD Mage's (D49: it holds that kit and knows Flame Bolt VI). The spine (spec section 5.4; D17). D3's cut line (m6-plan.md section 3): if week 2 runs over, the Holding's profile and read are cut, M6 ends at 80 with the den as home and M7 opens with the Holding
sources.alternates: tusker-armory (0x5948), first (M6 14 armory; the owner, 2026-11-14: try the Tusker Armory as the climber's next ground; cache/m6/next-ground/survey.md sections 3.1 and 4): its 67 Armored Tuskers (level 100, 435 health, Magic Defense 275, fire 1.0, 80,000 experience, melee bludgeon only) behind a 345 m run from the Barracks drop, a quarter of the Holding's. While the Holding is held by its approach (approach-held, approach-costly or approach-abandoned) the way out takes the first alternate whose own approach is recorded, judged on her live state and open, and whose portal and route admit her (RungOwner.TakeAlternate, AlternateRefusal): the Armory, the one alternate that records its approach; the band, the gate (the bot's VII lines), the bolt plan and the target margin stay this rung's, and a check that is not a way out hunts it while the session holds the Holding (approach-session:holding). With the Armory held too she hunts the previous rung's ground, as before. tusker-temple-fort-tethana (0x5C4A) and black-spawn-den-aluvian (0x0105): the den and the Temple as the fallback (strategy section 1.2 row 75-100); both resolve today. tusker-quarters (0x5B4A): if the Holding fails its 30-minute read, the Quarters and the Temple 40+ are the 80-100 ground (spec section 5.3); resolves today (M6 3 p2)
